semiconductor_relevance: High — Hong-Ming Technology specializes in precision custom spectroscopy and DUV metrology, which are critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Hong-Ming Technology Co., Ltd. is a leading supplier of customized spectroscopic instruments, focusing on positioning and inspection solutions for the semiconductor and electronics industries. They provide advanced inspection tools and measurement solutions, particularly in Deep Ultraviolet (DUV) spectral analysis, essential for next-generation semiconductor technologies.
